business.tagline: Restoring perfection, one dent at a time.

hero.eyebrow: Mobile paintless dent repair · DFW Metroplex
hero.intro: Door dings, creases and hail damage pushed out from behind the panel by a certified PDR technician. No filler, no repaint, and he comes to you.

services_heading: If the paint's not cracked, it can probably come out.
services_intro: Paintless dent repair works the metal back into shape with rods and glue tabs, so your factory paint and finish stay original.

services.title: Door dings
services.text: Parking lot dings and small round dents from shopping carts and car doors.

services.title: Creases
services.text: Long, sharp lines along body panels where something dragged or pressed in.

services.title: Hail damage
services.text: Roofs, hoods and trunks peppered by a Texas storm, often without touching paint.

services.title: Minor bumps
services.text: Light fender-bender dents, depending on where they are and how the metal stretched.

services_note: Cracked paint, torn metal or damage underneath the panel usually needs a body shop. Send a photo and you'll get a straight answer either way.
steps_heading: Three steps, zero trips to a shop.

steps.title: Text a photo
steps.text: Snap the dent in good light and text it to 682-308-6636. You'll get a price back, usually the same day.

steps.title: He comes to you
steps.text: Pick a time. Cannon brings the tools and light board to your driveway or workplace anywhere in DFW.

steps.title: Dent's gone
steps.text: Most single dents take an hour or two. The repair is permanent and the dent won't come back.

about.text2: When you book, the person who quotes your dent is the person who fixes it.

area.text: Based in Mansfield and working across the Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex. Home, office or the parking lot at work all work fine.

faq.question: What is PDR?
faq.answer: Paintless dent removal (or repair) takes out minor dents and dings without removing or touching the paint. It also handles creases and hail damage.

faq.question: How is it done?
faq.answer: A trained technician gently and patiently massages the dent out from behind the panel using specialized tools. Done right, it looks like the dent was never there.

faq.question: Does it work on fender benders?
faq.answer: Often, yes. It depends on where the damage is and the type of metal. If the damage is severe or there's damage under the body panel, a body shop is the better call, and you'll be told so.

faq.question: Will my dent come back?
faq.answer: No. Once a quality technician finishes the repair, the dent stays out.

faq.question: Do I need to bring my car anywhere?
faq.answer: Usually not. Most repairs happen wherever your vehicle is parked, anywhere in the DFW Metroplex. The exception is heavy hail damage: if the repair will take longer than about 8 hours, you may need to drop the vehicle off. You'll know which it is when you get your quote.
